cover.desc: Full color, cold high-contrast palette. Kanade in the tower, pale silver hair loose and lifting, bare hands open at her sides, standing squarely in the foreground with her back three-quarters to the viewer, facing into a white void. Behind her and slightly out of focus, Kou in the black coat, sword low, one step back — for the first time she is the one in front. Hard-edged shadow shapes, teal and bone white, one small amber light behind them marking the arch. Colored lineart, large flat fields, negative space top third.

panels.action: Monday. Four days until Thursday.

dialogue.text: Monday.
Four days. I've told one lie and it's holding.
It only has to hold until Thursday. Then it stops mattering.

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: walking the corridor, nodding left and right

panels.action: First in the year, running the morning.

chars.expression: falling into step, not looking at her

chars.expression: genuinely fond, which she cannot help

panels.action: The line under her name.

dialogue.text: ARIAKE K. — FRONT.
Front. Not flank.

panels.action: Gen provides the wrong interpretation with total confidence.

Front.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: reading it in another corridor, thumb hovering

dialogue.text: Saturday. We'll talk Saturday.

He'll have read it twice. He reads everything twice.
Saturday. We'll talk Saturday.

chars.name: pike

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: stopping, knowing exactly what this is

dialogue.text: Front.
Front.
I told you so you'd understand it. Not so you'd use it.

panels.action: She has the argument ready and it is a good argument.

dialogue.text: I'm on nothing. He's on ten. One of us can afford a thread.
That's the maths. Congratulations, it's correct.

chars.name: pike
chars.expression: one eye steady, no joke anywhere

panels.action: He tells her the part the maths leaves out.

dialogue.text: You've never lost one. You don't know what it's like to want something less.

panels.action: She does not move.

dialogue.text: Then I'll lose one and find out.
Ariake.
He's been doing it for thirteen months without telling me.

chars.name: pike
chars.pose: hands going back into his pockets

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: on the counter, arms folded, braced

You said that in March.

panels.action: He asks it without turning round, which is how he asks anything difficult.

dialogue.text: Front means you hold the line.
Yes.
Then no.

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: hands flat on the counter beside her

panels.action: She uses his own sentence, which she has been saving.

dialogue.text: You didn't ask me for thirteen months.
I'm asking. That's already better than you managed.

panels.action: There is no answer to that and he knows it.

dialogue.text: She's right and it doesn't matter.
I'd rather be wrong than watch it take something off her.

chars.name: kou
chars.pose: leaning back on the counter opposite

panels.action: The compromise, negotiated like a rota because that is all they have.

dialogue.text: Ten metres. Not thirty.
Fifteen.
Ten, and you come out when I say out.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: holding out a hand across the kitchen

dialogue.text: Ten metres. Left is mine. Agreed.

I've never had to hold you to anything before.
You're shaking on it like it's a supply contract.
It is a supply contract.

panels.bg: flat tone field, two hands gripped, one bandaged forearm above the other, warm light, tone-washed
panels.action: The handshake. Neither of them lets go quickly.

dialogue.text: Say it again.

panels.action: Register switch, one panel.

dialogue.text: No.
THAT WAS A CONTRACT. THAT WAS A PROFESSIONAL CONTRACT.
It was four seconds.
IT WAS THREE.

panels.action: Shizu leaves for the night shift and says one thing on her way past.

dialogue.text: There's a girl in the kitchen again.
There is.
Good.
Goodnight, Hazama-san.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: caught completely off guard by one word

panels.action: It is the first opinion Shizu has expressed in six chapters.

dialogue.text: Shizu. You're on my floor enough for that.
She said good.
A woman on fourteen said good.
She's never said good about anything.

chars.name: nabari
chars.expression: at his desk, roster in hand, frowning

panels.action: Wednesday evening. Nabari signs the Thursday roster.

dialogue.text: Hall two. Kirisu, Hazama, and Ariake.
Ariake on front. On a training floor. With a blank pin and a twelve.

chars.name: nabari
chars.expression: looking at the wall chart of layers

panels.action: He looks at the chart with the red line through thirty-three.

dialogue.text: Training floor. Layer nine. Perfectly safe.
Which is exactly what I would put on a roster if I were lying.

panels.action: He signs it anyway. He has four hundred students and one folder.

dialogue.text: Every year there's one I could stop.
And every year I find out afterwards which one it was.

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: in the office doorway, tablet down at her side

panels.action: Riko is in the doorway and has been for a few seconds.

dialogue.text: Mizusawa. It's half seven.
Sir. Is Ariake-san on the Thursday roster.
She is.

chars.name: riko
chars.expression: very still, deciding in real time

panels.action: The whole chapter balances here for about two seconds.

dialogue.text: I could end this with one sentence.
She'd never speak to me again, and she'd be intact, and she'd hate me.

panels.action: She chooses.

dialogue.text: Nothing, sir. Goodnight.
Mizusawa.
It's nothing. Really.
If it's nothing, say nothing tomorrow as well.
...Sir.

chars.name: riko
chars.pose: small figure alone in a long dark corridor

panels.bg: flat tone field, one small silhouette in a corridor of tall windows, evening light
panels.action: She stands in the corridor afterwards for a long time.

dialogue.text: Two years I've protected her from things she wanted.
This is the first one she chose.

panels.action: She sends one message instead.

dialogue.text: I know it's tomorrow.
I'm not telling anyone. Come back and tell me it was worth it.

panels.action: Kanade reads it and does not reply for four minutes.

dialogue.text: She worked it out on Friday and she's been carrying it since Friday.
She's been carrying it alone for six days.

panels.action: She sends four words.

dialogue.text: Thank you. I will.
You'd better.
I'll come and tell you on Friday. Properly.
With words. Out loud.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: sitting on the futon in the dark, awake

panels.bg: apartment at night, thin light through the curtain, tone-washed
panels.action: Wednesday night. He is not asleep.

dialogue.text: Ten metres. She comes out when I say out.
I have never once said out and had her go.

panels.action: He rewraps the forearm. He does it the way she does it now, without noticing.

dialogue.text: Two loops. Flat on the outside of the wrist.
I do it her way now. I don't remember deciding to.

chars.name: shizu
chars.expression: in the doorway, home early, coat still on

panels.action: Shizu is home four hours early and does not explain why.

dialogue.text: You're awake at two.
So are you.
I swapped my shift. I'm on the booths tomorrow night.

panels.action: She swapped her shift to be in the booth tomorrow night.

dialogue.text: She knows. She's known since the roster went up.

panels.action: She says the closest thing to affection she has left.

dialogue.text: Kou. If it takes one off her, don't apologise to her for it.
Why.
Because she'll have chosen it. Let her have chosen it.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: hair down, coat on, entirely calm

panels.bg: dive hall two, Thursday half seven, equipment racks, tone-washed
panels.action: Thursday. Hall two.

dialogue.text: For the record: I said this was stupid.
Noted.
I want it in the actual record. Written down.

panels.action: He wraps her forearm for the first time. Two loops, flat on the outside of the wrist.

dialogue.text: That's my knot.
It's a good knot.

panels.action: She looks at it for slightly too long.

dialogue.text: He said good knot on a bridge thirteen months ago.
I have thought about that sentence an unreasonable number of times.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: level, giving the order he agreed to give

panels.action: The rules, said out loud so all three of them have heard them.

dialogue.text: Ten metres. You hold the line. I take your right.
When I say out, you go first. Not last.
Understood.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: steady, lying with her whole face

panels.action: She has no intention of going first and he cannot tell.

dialogue.text: Understood is not a promise.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: small in frame, standing furthest in
chars.pose: at the front, hair lifting, hands open

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: small in frame, one step behind her right

chars.name: pike
chars.expression: small in frame at the threshold

panels.bg: the vast white void of layer thirty-three, no ceiling, no shadows, thin architectural lines, drifting motes, heavy negative space, tone-washed
panels.action: Layer thirty-three, second visit. This time she is in front.

dialogue.text: One. Two. Three.
Clock's running. Ten metres and I'm dragging you both out.
Four. Five.
It's warm in here. Did you know that? It's warm.
She's describing the room to me. In the room.
Seven. Eight.

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: walking at the front, hands open

panels.bg: white void, faint floor line, tone-washed
panels.action: She counts and describes at the same time.

dialogue.text: Nine. Ten. That's ten, stop walking.
Stopping.
Nine. Ten. That's ten.
Hold there.

chars.name: pike
chars.expression: at the threshold, one hand on the arch

panels.bg: the dark arch behind, white void ahead, tone-washed
panels.action: PIKE holds the door and hates every second of it.

dialogue.text: Ten metres. Clock's running.
Thirty seconds and I'm coming in after both of you.
Twenty will do.

panels.bg: white void, the arch a small dark rectangle behind them, tone-washed
panels.action: Ten metres. They stop. Nothing happens for four full seconds.

dialogue.text: Ten. Mapping.
Floor's flat. No seams. It's one piece.
There's no far wall. I can't find a far wall.
Six seconds and I'm calling it. Five.
Understood.
There's nothing here. There's genuinely nothing here.

panels.action: Something moves and he turns the wrong way.

dialogue.text: Behind. Where. WHERE.

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: stepping across in front of him

panels.action: She steps across him without being told. This is the whole chapter.

dialogue.text: Left, four metres, low.
I've got it. I'm the line. Stay on my right.

chars.name: pike
chars.expression: shouting from the arch, moving in

panels.bg: white void, the arch behind, tone-washed
panels.action: PIKE calls it early because he is the one being paid to.

dialogue.text: That's a shape. There's a shape in here.
OUT. That's the call. OUT.

panels.action: He says the word they agreed on.

dialogue.text: Ariake. OUT. You first.
In a moment.
That's a shape. That is definitely a shape.

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: standing square between him and the white

panels.bg: white void, everything featureless, motion lines, tone-washed
panels.action: She does not move. He cannot move her without letting go of the sword.

dialogue.text: Go. I'm eleven seconds behind you.
That's not the agreement.
No. It isn't.
Eleven seconds. She said eleven. I'm holding her to it.

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: looking back over her shoulder at him

panels.action: She says it over her shoulder, in his own words, and it is the worst thing she has ever done to him.

dialogue.text: You'd have said no.
Ariake. OUT.
Eleven seconds.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: hearing his own sentence come back

panels.action: His hand opens.

dialogue.text: That's mine. That's my sentence.
This is what it sounds like from the other side.
She means it. She'll do it whether you're standing there or not.

panels.bg: white void toward the dark arch, motion, tone-washed
panels.action: PIKE makes the decision for both of them, which is what a front-liner is for.

dialogue.text: Move. MOVE. She's eleven seconds, she said eleven seconds.
ARIAKE.
I am not losing two of you in one term.

chars.name: kanade
chars.pose: one small solid figure alone, standing, arms slightly out

panels.bg: flat white tone field, one black silhouette, no other feature anywhere in the frame
panels.action: One person alone in a white room, standing between it and the door.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: through the arch, on his knees, turning back

panels.bg: dark landing of thirty-two, the white arch blazing, tone-washed
panels.action: Eleven seconds is a very long time.

dialogue.text: Four. Five.
Let go of me.
Six. Seven. You go in there and it charges you both.
Eight.
Nine. Come on. Come on.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: staring at the white, absolutely still

panels.action: He counts with him and hates every number.

dialogue.text: Nine. Ten.
This is what I've done to her every Thursday for thirteen months.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: walking out of the white, upright, unhurried

panels.bg: the arch, white behind her, dark stone ahead, tone-washed
panels.action: She walks out at eleven. She does not stumble either.

dialogue.text: Eleven.
You absolute nightmare of a woman.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: up, hands on her shoulders, checking her like equipment
chars.pose: gripping her coat at both shoulders

panels.action: He checks her the way she checks him.

dialogue.text: Say something.
Something.
Don't. What can you feel.

panels.action: She runs her own inventory out loud, because that is what she does.

dialogue.text: Cold stone. Your hands. My own heartbeat, annoyingly.
Everything's here. I'm fine.
Nothing missing?
Nothing I can find standing here.

chars.name: shizu
chars.expression: at the booth desk, headset on

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: in the calibration chair, upright, composed

panels.action: Booth four. Shizu swapped her shift for this.

dialogue.text: Tone at forty. Say when.
Now.
Colours. Read the card.
Do it in the usual order. I've watched you do his.
You've watched too many of his.

panels.action: Colours, textures, temperature. All clean.

dialogue.text: Blue. Green. Grey. The strip's rough on the left edge.
Correct. Temperature.
Hot. Very. You're testing me with tea.
Textures. Left edge or right.

chars.name: shizu
chars.expression: pausing over the form, the first pause in her life

panels.action: Shizu stops. She does not stop.

dialogue.text: Left. Definitely left.
Last one. Something you want.
Sorry?
Name something you want. Right now. Quickly.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: answering instantly, without thinking at all

panels.action: She answers before she has decided to.

dialogue.text: Saturday.

panels.action: Shizu writes the number and says it without any weight at all.

dialogue.text: Count: one.
...One.
Smell. You've lost smell.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: sitting in the chair afterwards, alone, working it out
chars.pose: very still, hands in her lap

panels.bg: empty booth, one lamp, night, tone-washed
panels.action: She sits in the chair after Shizu leaves and tests it herself.

dialogue.text: It doesn't feel like anything. That's the part nobody says.
There's no gap. There's just nothing where a thing was.
Sit for ten minutes before you stand up.
I'm fine.
Everyone says that. Sit down.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: holding the tea under her nose, nothing happening

panels.action: She puts the tea directly under her nose. Steam, and no information.

dialogue.text: Grassy. It was grassy. I wrote it down.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: taking out the notebook, opening it

panels.action: She opens her own list.

dialogue.text: Tea — grassy, bitter at the end.
Burnt rice — sharp at the edges.
Melon bread — sweet, crisp on top.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: the first real crack, small, private

panels.action: She wrote the list for him. It has become a record of what she used to have.

dialogue.text: I wrote it for him.
I'm going to need it.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: closing the book, standing, composing herself

panels.action: She fixes her face in the dark glass of the booth door and goes out.

dialogue.text: He is in that corridor and he is going to ask.
And I am not going to let him apologise for it.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: waiting against the corridor wall, jacket on
chars.pose: standing exactly where she stood for him

panels.bg: corridor of numbered booths, night, tone-washed
panels.action: He is standing in exactly the place she stood two weeks ago.

dialogue.text: Well?
One.
Smell. Which is the least useful one, so that's efficient.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: everything happening behind the mild face

panels.action: He opens his mouth to apologise.

dialogue.text: Ariake, I—

panels.action: She does what his sister told him to let her do.

dialogue.text: No. I chose it. You don't get to be sorry about my choice.
That's my line as well.
Yes. It's a very good line. I've taken it.

chars.name: kou
chars.pose: leaning back against the wall beside her

panels.action: They stand against the same wall.

dialogue.text: Eleven seconds is a very long time.
I know. I counted them from the inside.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: matter-of-fact, and it costs her nothing to say
chars.pose: head tipped back against the wall

panels.action: She gives him the reason, plainly, and it is the closest thing to a confession in seven chapters.

dialogue.text: You've been paying for thirteen months.
I wanted to know what it cost. Now I do. It's fine.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: at the stove, Saturday, sleeves up

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: on the counter in her usual place

panels.action: Saturday. The rota. Neither of them cancelled it.

dialogue.text: Three and a half cups. Pike's number. Testing it.
Under protest.
Noted.
Under protest, and I want that in the book.
It'll go in the book.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: tasting, and it is still all there
chars.pose: spoon in both hands, eyes closed

panels.action: She can still taste. She checks every single time now, and never says so.

dialogue.text: Still there. Still all there.

panels.action: The verdict on PIKE's number.

dialogue.text: It's better. It's annoyingly better.
I'll write it down.
Write that it was under protest.

panels.bg: flat tone field, the notebook, two lines in terrible handwriting under years of numbers, tone-washed

Rice: 3.5 cups. (Pike — under protest, K.)

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: not looking up from the book

panels.action: He asks it without looking up.

dialogue.text: Does it smell like anything? The rice.
No.
Right.
It's fine. It's the least useful one.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: sitting on the kitchen floor beside her

panels.bg: kitchen floor, Saturday afternoon light, tone-washed
panels.action: The floor again. It is becoming a place.

dialogue.text: It smells like burnt edges and steam.
You can't smell either.
No. But I wrote it down when I could.

panels.action: He has a list too. He has had one for two years.

dialogue.text: He kept one. All this time, he kept one.

chars.name: kou
chars.expression: holding out an old, battered second notebook
chars.pose: arm extended, not looking at her

panels.action: He gives her the second notebook. It is much older than hers.

dialogue.text: It's mostly food. Some of it's weather.
Hazama.
You'll want one. Start from mine. It's a head start.

chars.name: kanade
chars.expression: taking it in both hands, not opening it yet
chars.pose: holding it flat on her knees

panels.action: Neither of them says anything for a while.

dialogue.text: Thursday.
Thursday.
And I'm still on front.

panels.action: Somewhere across the city a supervisor is reading a calibration report with two names on it.

dialogue.text: We'll talk about it.
We won't.
ARIAKE K. — COUNT: 1. HAZAMA K. — COUNT: 10.
